WITH inputs(i,a,b,sigma,lo,hi,old,cached) AS (VALUES
(0,'0.3734184904561133'::float8,'0.9697689883942827'::float8,'1.3499999999999999'::float8,3,12,12,false),
(1,'0.5336203798921629'::float8,'0.9530070765745594'::float8,'6.75'::float8,15,60,60,true),
(2,'0.9295600311517099'::float8,'0.9201622665644099'::float8,'6.75'::float8,15,60,60,true)
),angles AS (SELECT *,a*'6.283185307179586'::float8 AS angle,sqrt('-2.0'::float8*ln('1.0'::float8-b)) AS radius FROM inputs),
noise AS (SELECT *, '0.0'::float8+(CASE WHEN cached THEN sin(angle) ELSE cos(angle) END*radius)*sigma AS n FROM angles)
SELECT i,encode(float8send(n),'hex') AS noise_bits,floor(least(hi::float8,greatest(lo::float8,old::float8+n))+'0.5'::float8)::integer AS period FROM noise ORDER BY i;
